stage: P5.13-C — relocation of the ESS ageing constants into SRP1_ESS_Params.json
status: FROZEN GATE — written and hashed BEFORE any source edit
authorization: author, 2026-09-12: behaviour-preserving refactor, first production code change in this sequence; defaults must reproduce current values exactly; prove neutrality rather than assert it; include the calibration triple in the file schema; stop and report if exact neutrality cannot be achieved
roles: Worker unavailable; the Planner is both author and verifier, which is why the gate is frozen before the edit and its verdict is mechanical

change_permitted.nature: read t_cal, cl_nom, dod_nom and soh_min from the ESS parameters file, applying them to each SharedEnergyStorage instance at creation; add a declared-only degradation calibration block to the schema

defaults.rule: every default must equal the value currently hard-coded in shared_energy_storage.py:18-21, so that an absent key reproduces today's behaviour exactly

change_forbidden: any change to the degradation law, the SoH chain, bounds, tolerances or any constraint expression

consumption of the calibration triple by the law — the triple is DECLARED in the schema and read into the parameters object, but no constraint may depend on it in this change; consuming it requires the author's (N, D, R) decision and is not behaviour-neutral
any change to shared_energy_storage.py's numerical values
any change to case data other than adding the new keys to SRP1_ESS_Params.json
any solver invocation: this gate is structural and runs no solve

invariants.I1: for each of the three ESSO models, the ordered semantic state (variables with bounds/fixed flags/values, Params, and every constraint expression rendered as a string, in deterministic order) must be byte-identical pre- and post-edit
invariants.I2: for each of the three ESSO models, the .nl export must be byte-identical pre- and post-edit
invariants.I3: on every SharedEnergyStorage object in every representative year, (t_cal, cl_nom, dod_nom, soh_min) == (15, 10000, 0.80, 0.50) post-edit, matching pre-edit
invariants.I4: the objective, feasibility-penalty and salvage expression strings must be identical pre- and post-edit
invariants.I5: the post-edit git diff must be confined to the three files listed in change_permitted plus this stage's own artifacts

procedure: 1. freeze this specification and hash it (done before any edit)
2. run p513_c_param_move_gate.py in 'capture' mode on the UNMODIFIED tree -> baseline manifest
4. run the same harness in 'capture' mode -> post manifest
5. run the harness in 'compare' mode; it must report equality on I1-I4, and the Planner checks I5 from the diff

decision_rule.pass: all of I1-I5 equal; the refactor is then recorded as behaviour-neutral and every existing result remains valid unchanged
decision_rule.fail: ANY inequality — the edit is reverted and the difference reported; no attempt may be made to argue that a difference is immaterial

what_this_gate_does_not_prove: it does not re-run any ADMM trajectory or solve; it proves that the model handed to the solver is identical, which is the property the refactor claims
it does not address the calibration decision (N, D, R), which remains open and blocking
